headline: Revenue grows strongly as bookings miss on monetization dip
summary_short: Q2 FY2026 revenue rose 36% y/y to $1,469M as bookings grew just 8% y/y to $1,557M — the low end of guidance — on a mix shift toward lower-monetizing games and a discovery-algorithm change favoring retention over near-term spend.
summary_long: Q2 2026 revenue rose 36% y/y to $1,469M; bookings grew just 8% y/y to $1,557M, the low end of guidance, as a mix shift toward lower-monetizing new/evergreen games and RFY algorithm changes favoring retention weighed on monetization. DAUs grew 10% to 123M, Hours grew 5% to 29B. Consolidated net loss narrowed to $185M from $280M; Adjusted EBITDA (company definition) rose to $152M from $18M, aided by a $34M legal-settlement addback. Operating cash flow was $318M (+60% y/y) and free cash flow $294M (+66% y/y). Total cash and investments reached $6.1B, up $1.4B y/y, after $380M of buybacks under the new $3B authorization. Q3 2026 guidance: revenue +4% to +10% y/y, bookings down 14% to 18% y/y.

drivers.explanation: Revenue and DAU growth stayed strong, but bookings landed at the low end of guidance on a mix shift toward lower-monetizing new/evergreen games and RFY algorithm changes prioritizing long-term retention over near-term monetization.

GAAP revenue reflects bookings recognized over the ~27-month average paying-user lifetime, so current-period revenue largely captures flow-through from prior periods' bookings, including elevated 2025 bookings.
Cost of revenue rose 24% y/y in dollars, but fell as a share of bookings because a larger share of bookings ran through lower-cost payment platforms, cutting processing fees.
Loss from operations narrowed as revenue growth outpaced cost growth, even as infrastructure/trust & safety spend rose 54% y/y on AI investment and safety-related marketing.
Consolidated net loss narrowed to $185M from $280M on the same revenue-outpacing-costs dynamic as operating income.
Equity fell from $432M to $152M q/q as the accumulated deficit grew (H1 2026 net loss of $429M attributable to common stockholders) alongside $375-380M of share repurchases.
Cash fell $197M in the quarter as $372M used in financing activities (mainly $375M of buybacks) outweighed $318M of operating cash flow and net investing inflows.

confidence_notes: REGENERATION (force-regen run): no prior summary existed on disk for this period at generation time; this run composes a fresh filing-depth summary per the force-regenerate directive. Adjusted EBITDA ($152M) is Roblox's own non-GAAP measure (net loss + interest + taxes + D&A + stock-based comp + a $34M legal-settlement addback) and is deliberately NOT included as a KPI-table row alongside SEC-verbatim operating/net income figures, to avoid conflating an adjusted, company-defined measure with unadjusted GAAP lines sourced from the same event's kpis object; it is cited only in summary_long/drivers with its own attribution. Basic and diluted EPS are identical each period per the filing (no dilutive effect given the net loss), so a single combined EPS row is used rather than duplicate basic/diluted rows. Bookings ($1,557M Q2 2026 actual, +8% y/y) is the release's own non-GAAP reconciliation of revenue plus the change in deferred revenue; it is distinct from GAAP revenue and is not included as a core KPI row (no comparable field on the resolver's kpis object) but is quoted directly in summary_short/summary_long since it is the metric the release itself frames the quarter around. Quarter-over-quarter buyback and net-income prior-quarter values on the shard mix SEC-verbatim (Q1 2026 10-Q) and Yahoo-sourced provenance for a couple of fields (net_income_usd_m prior_qq, operating_income_usd_m prior_qq/prior_yy) — deltas computed from these are directionally consistent with the filing's own y/y net-loss narrowing ($280M to $185M consolidated) and are not cross-basis surprise pairs, so the same-basis rule does not gate them. Roblox stated it is accelerating its transition to quarterly-only guidance by one quarter, issuing Q3 2026 guidance but no full-year 2026 outlook; the seven Q3 2026 guidance line items (revenue, bookings, consolidated net loss, Adjusted EBITDA, operating cash flow, free cash flow, capex) were written to the event's guidance array with move='initiated' since this is the first quarter reported under the new quarterly-only cadence, not a change from a prior explicit Q3 range.
